benefits.name: Shore Excursion Statement Credit
benefits.description: 10% statement credit on shore excursion packages purchased on Carnival.com prior to sailing.
benefits.terms: Credit is 10% of the excursion package price (taxes/fees excluded), not a fixed dollar amount; must be booked on Carnival.com before the cruise. Card is scheduled to convert to the Carnival Rewards Mastercard in September 2026 with a new benefits structure — confirm this benefit still applies after that date.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage against damage or theft of a cell phone when the monthly phone bill is paid with the card, as a standard World Mastercard benefit.
benefits.terms: Standard Mastercard World-tier benefit; requires paying the monthly cell phone bill with this card. Confirm current coverage limit/deductible via the Mastercard Guide to Benefits, as terms are set by Mastercard and can change independent of this card record.

earningRates.terms: Carnival Cruise Line and other Carnival Corporation brands (Princess, Holland America, Cunard, Costa, Seabourn, P&O Cruises, AIDA). Card is scheduled to convert to the Carnival Rewards Mastercard in September 2026 with a new earning structure — confirm this rate still applies after that date.
